digitization.method: Approximate blue marker centers from the manufacturer PNG; power rounded to 5 W and thrust to 0.05 kgf.
digitization.warning: These are digitized graph estimates, not a manufacturer CSV or measured command calibration.

assumptions.voltage: Fixed 48 V, based on the module specification. The chart does not label its test voltage.
assumptions.command: Normalized command magnitude approximates shaft speed; electrical power scales with command magnitude cubed.
assumptions.power_limit: 570 W default is the specification maximum, not a readback of the installed motor power-manager setting.
assumptions.reverse: Default reverse thrust mirrors forward; the stock propeller is forward optimized and reverse data is unavailable.
assumptions.low_power: Below the first chart point, extrapolate thrust proportional to electrical power to the 2/3 power.
assumptions.dynamics: Steady static thrust; no measured startup, battery sag or advance-speed correction.
